database_models.User: Authentication, accounts, credentials (passwordHash), tokens, voice participants, message references
database_models.RefreshToken: Secure JWT rotation credentials linked to User entities
database_models.Workspace: Orchestrates memberships, invite tokens, channels, custom domains, and tunnels
database_models.Membership: Controls role permissions (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER) for workspace access
database_models.ApiKey: Exposes standard authorization credentials prefixed with 'opk_'
database_models.Tunnel: Stores localPort, protocol, subdomain, region, status, and publicUrl for relay connections
database_models.RequestLog: Stores request method, path, headers, durationMs, and captured body payloads
database_models.Channel: Isolates TEXT or VOICE room contexts inside a workspace
database_models.Message: Supports regular CHAT or yellow-card FEEDBACK message resolution inside text channels
database_models.VoiceParticipant: Tracks active participants joined in voice rooms
database_models.BandwidthUsage: Measures total bytesIn and bytesOut across tunnels for billing/limits check
database_models.InviteToken: Generates invite tokens to register memberships inside a workspace
database_models.Domain: Stores verificationToken and verified status for custom apex/subdomains
